notes: One class of common stock, priced from its primary listing on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (6758.T) rather than the NYSE ADS (SONY, 1 ADS = 1 share). Shares = 5,965,316,326 issued − 136,679,029 treasury = 5,828,637,297 at October 31, 2026, from Sony's monthly share-repurchase status report filed on Form 6-K on November 12, 2026, which states both parts but not the difference. The 20-F count (6,149,810,645 issued including 242,144,891 treasury at March 31, 2026) is stale: Sony cancelled 184,494 thousand treasury shares on May 29, 2026 and has bought 86,065,800 shares under its program of up to 230 million shares or ¥500 billion running May 11, 2026 to May 10, 2027, so the edition-date count is slightly lower than recorded.
